notes.title: Navigation update
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!
We’ve recently shared our update plan with you. Today we would like to present the first update from this list. SKYHILL: Black Mist is quite a big game and the players might get lost in it. The game’s world is constantly expanding, and over time, you might have gotten lost in the Skyhill condominium. In order to solve this problem, our designers have thought of a nifty navigation system. This update is dedicated to this new feature. In addition, we’ve paid great attention to the details that’ll make it easier for you to interact with the game world. We sincerely hope that you will test this update and tell us about your impressions!

Below we’ll tell you in detail what we’ve included in the update.

The navigation system that shows the nearest transitions between the locations, objects that can be unlocked with special items, and story signals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953130/a1ac16eea131eee038eafecf1b2f61d554740ffb.png

In addition, we've almost completely redesigned the game’s main menu and tested all the system settings:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953130/f28c9ca410ee42215e2b448facbcf6e8d7535a07.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953130/757dbd62fb35fa015d63f9fe40886148333f8846.png

We’ve redesigned the interfaces for interacting with loot containers:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953130/92aa50b1d96cbd76990392059436d190bf47a910.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953130/32a775c294fa42dc2238a6eb833d844da29416aa.png

We’ve also significantly changed the level design in the first phase of the game (if you haven’t gone far, it is advisable to start the game over to see the changes.)

In addition:


 We’ve made many fixes and improvements to the inventory and craft systems
 We’ve added the ability to skip cutscenes
 Many fixes for the save game system
 Improved interfaces for interacting with objects
 Reworked and fixed the player status system
 Fixed many bugs in level design
 Completely rebuilt the pause menu and tested all settings
 Fixed serious graphics performance issues, especially on scenes with city views
 Fixed the trajectory of throwing bottles and Molotov cocktails
 Fixed broken screen resolution setting
 Fixed brightness settings
 Fixed names of locations during transitions
 Improved the subtitle system
 Now when you pick up the story notes, they immediately open for reading
 Fixed problems with item descriptions, and we’ve also added item descriptions right in containers
 Fixed windowed mode settings
 Fixed saving of player’s containers
 Now all items, statuses, recipes are correctly marked as new. Also, notifications are shown on the corresponding tabs about whether there are new items
 Improved GUI element redrawing optimization, which improves overall performance
 On the global map, only part of the locations for finding story signals is now shown initially
 Interactable objects are now marked with slightly visible particles for your convenience
 Now you can craft a recipe if one of the ingredients will empty a slot of the filled inventory
 Added some new tutorials


We may have forgotten to add something to this list. In any case, we are continuing to work on the game. Please share your feedback with us on the forums. It’s very important for us. At this point, we have moved on to the next item in terms of updates.

Have a killer Halloween!

Eugene @ Mandragora

notes.title: Important news! Further plans, independence. When is the update?
notes.notes:
Hi! My name is Eugene. I’m the founder of the Mandragora studio. In this post, I’d like to tell you what’s going on with SKYHILL: Black Mist now, and also share our plans for the project’s development.

In retrospect

Our game’s rating was 17% the day after the release. We admit that the game was released with serious technical issues that prevented many of you from enjoying your survival at the Skyhill condominium.

We tried to fix the main technical issues with urgent updates within the next 2-3 weeks. We watched a huge number of streams and recorded walkthroughs. And we are very pleased that the rating has increased to 54%. Thank you for your support! But we are not going to stop at this, for sure.

Independence

After some time, we made a difficult decision to develop the game further on our own without our publisher. If you look at the game's publisher line on the game’s Steam page, you’ll notice that Mandragora is now both the developer and the only publisher on PC. This is a mutual decision and we’ll remain on good terms with our publisher. But we’d like to talk about the future now, instead of focusing on the past.

What’s next?

We’d like you to fully immerse in the world of SKYHILL: Black Mist we created. All this time, we have continued to work on a major update, which will be released very soon. We’ve divided the work on the game into major updates, each of which contains the addition of new content, mechanics, and numerous improvements and bug fixes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953130/6160c0db32ae335f08216b8be32f1a903b19e899.jpg

Updates will first appear in the beta branch. You can access it like this:

How to participate in beta-testing?

Please feel free to leave your feedback and report bugs to our Steam forum, as well as our Discord, where you can communicate directly with the development team. And you can learn about the updates’ release dates by subscribing to the game’s page on Steam.

We've uploaded a new build to beta_testing right now, so you can already have a sneak peek at the upcoming updates and help us develop the game!

Don't forget to join our Discord-server

notes.title: Personal storages update! - 1.0.200
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953130/43b622f269609c70e8973d10447764783315afea.png

Hello everyone, We keep watching and analyzing the way you play our game on streams and videos. We have noticed that one of the major problems that you encounter is the fact that storages at the obelisks are barely used because there aren’t many obelisks in the game and they all are located pretty far from each other. So, we’ve decided to detach the storage functionality from the obelisks and to introduce Personal Storages as separate objects. Now they are situated in the majority of locations and this will let you use this functionality at its maximum. Besides, one of the storages is located in the hub next to the Skyhill Inc. terminal. 

Also, this patch is centered around stability of the saving system. We’ve found many situations when the system didn’t work as it was supposed to work, and it led to dead end situations and, what is worse, to a complete loss of game progress.

Besides that we keep on perfecting different aspects of the game. Here’s the entire list of modifications and updates: 


 Updated to more stable Unity version
 Lot of bug fixing and optimisation for Save System
 Additional video-cutscenes
 Added movement by mouse, fixed aiming by mouse
 Blind monsters became more dangerous. They catch hero even while running
 Player storage now not in the obelisk. You can find it on different locations
 When you eat something the GUI on heart refreshes at this moment. Not only when you close inventory
 Fixed character statuses icons in the top left corner. Previously worked not correctly.
 Fixed IK bug when aim with firearms
 Increased mouse aim speed
 Fixed bug when fuse from safe where dropping on floor
 Fixed pathfinding on lot of locations
 Fixed key issue in second bossfight
 Fixed colliders for barricades
 Bossfight 3 colliders fixes
 Added additional secret passage between main hall and basement
 Added additional secret passage between main hall and cinema
 Changed running tutorial on the bridge
 Added random for boxes in third bossfight
 Moved savepoints in the beginning of the game, added some more for boss fights
 On first phase of the game added Seekers
 Fixed problem with non-active loot on locations 


We don’t stop here, of course. Next large patch will be focused on user interface and user experience optimization. 

We thank you for your patience and responsiveness and for good reviews about the game. We are working hard to make our game better. Don’t forget about our forum where you can always write about the bugs you find. We don’t always have time to answer you as our development team is rather small, but we do read every single message from you. Good luck to you on the windy road to survival in SKYHILL: Black Mist! 

- Mandragora
